title: Austin Homebuyer Loan Boost
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Approved the formal record of a previous meeting that authorized a key housing initiative.
*   This initiative included a $160,000 loan to Neighborhood Housing Services of Austin, Inc.
*   The funds are designated to assist first-time homebuyers and support community housing development.

AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING MINUTES
THURSDAY, May 12,2005
The Board of Directori of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened on
Thursday, May 12,2005, in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 301 W. 2M> Street, Austin, Texas.
The following were the AHFC items considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's
Board of Directors.
President Wynn called the meeting to order at 11:34 a.m.
AHFC-1 
Approve the minutes of the April 7, 2005 Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance
Corporation.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation meeting of April 7, 2005
were approved on Board Member McCracken'i motion, Vice President Goodman's
second on a 7-0 vote.
AHFC-2 
Authorize the negotiation and execution of a Community Housing Development
Organization loan under the Acquisition and Development Program in an amount not to
exceed $160,000 to NEIGHBORHOOD HOUSING SERVICES OF AUSTIN, INC,
Austin TX, a non-profit community-housing provider, to provide loans to first-time
homebuyers. (Funding is available in HOME grant funds allocated in the Fiscal Year
2004-2005 Austin Housing Finance Corporation budget.)
The motion authorizing the negotiation and execution of a Community Housing
Development was approved on Board Member Dunkerley*! motion, Board Member
Thomas' second on a 7-0 vote.
The meeting was adjourned without objection at 11:39 a.m.
